title: AI/ML Engineer - Production AI & LLM Systems (India)
description_html:
Headquarters: India
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/vBHEuzwk8ghJwdk43HHAzt/jobs-at-volga-partners

AI Engineer | India 

Department: Engineering 
Reports To: Product & Engineering Leadership 
Location: India - Fully Remote 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Experience Level: Mid-Level 
Compensation: ₹15,00,000 – ₹22,00,000 per year (15–22 LPA), commensurate with experience and technical expertise 
 

Position Overview 

The AI Engineer at Volga Partners will design, develop, and deploy advanced, production-ready AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation technologies.

This role requires a strong combination of AI research, hands-on model training and optimization, and software engineering expertise, with the ability to translate innovative AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and practical business applications.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership, the AI Engineer will lead the development and integration of high-performance AI solutions that solve complex business challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our global clients.

Key Responsibilities 

AI System Development 

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and ML/DL solutions.
  • Select appropriate models and architectures while balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity.
  • Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation.
  • Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption.
  • Build APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations.

Production & Optimization 

  • Own evaluation of metrics and track quality, latency, and cost.
  • Monitor, debug, and optimize AI systems post-launch.
  • Ensure production readiness and identify regressions before they impact users.

Collaboration

  • Partner with software engineers and product teams to integrate AI into applications.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and technical decision-making.
  • Document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions.

Research & Experimentation 

  • Read and evaluate ML research papers.  
  • Implement promising methods and reproducing results where applicable.  
  • Adapt emerging techniques into production-ready systems.  
  • Contribute to continued innovation across AI and engineering initiatives.  

Working Relationships 

The AI Engineer will collaborate with: 

  • Engineering leadership and product teams.
  • Software engineers and backend developers.
  • Global AI research and development teams.

Success in This Role 

Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models. 

You should be able to: 

  • Deliver production-ready AI systems with measurable impact.
  • Translate research into practical engineering solutions.
  • Collaborate effectively across distributed teams.
  • Document and share technical knowledge for scalability.
  • Adapt to evolving technical and business priorities.

Work Environment 

This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones. 
 

Required Work Schedule 

This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:30 PM–4:30 AM or 8:30 PM–5:30 AM IST in India, depending on U.S. daylight saving time?

The ability to consistently work the assigned schedule is a required and non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours and maintaining reliable availability throughout the assigned shift.

Due to project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities, occasional weekend availability or schedule adjustments may be required. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard schedule but flexibility to support business needs when necessary is expected

Our Hiring Process 

We value your time and aim to keep our recruitment process transparent, efficient, and engaging. 

1. Initial Recruiter Screening 

An introductory video call with a member of our Recruiting team to discuss your background, experience, career goals, salary expectations, and any initial questions you may have about the role or Volga Partners. 

2. Practical Skills Assessment 

Candidates who successfully complete the initial screening will receive a practical assessment to complete asynchronously. 

The assessment is designed to evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and how you approach a real-world engineering scenario. 

3. Assessment Review 

Our team will review your submission against the technical requirements of the role. 

Candidates who meet the required criteria will advance to the final interview stage.

4. Technical / Coding Interview
Candidates who pass the assessment will meet with our Engineering team to further evaluate their technical skills, experience, and AI Engineering knowledge

5. Final Interview – CTO 

A deep-dive conversation with our Chief Technology Officer focused on technical alignment, your assessment approach, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall alignment with the role and team. 

Required Qualifications 

  • 3+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production.
  • Strong NLP fundamentals, including tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, and information extraction.
  • Strong engineering skills across coding, Git, testing, API/system design, and debugging.
  • Hands-on model training experience using PyTorch or Keras.
  • Understanding generative model architectures, including Transformers and VAEs.
  • Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design.
  • Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Ability to read ML research papers and translate ideas into working code.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning, including LoRA and RL-based methods.
  • SQL database knowledge.
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and model-serving infrastructure.
  • Open-source contributions or experience reproducing research results.

Compensation & Benefits 

  • Annual Compensation: ₹15,00,000-₹22,00,000 (15-22 LPA), based on experience and technical expertise.  
  • Contract and payment administration facilitated through Deel.  
  • 90-day probationary period.  
  • Benefits eligibility upon successful completion of probation, including:  
    • Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy.  
    • Holiday pay for company-observed holidays.  
    • Career growth and professional development opportunities. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/volga-partners-ai-ml-engineer-production-ai-llm-systems-india

title: Software Engineer II
description_html:
Headquarters: India
URL: https://www.g-p.com

About Us

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About the Company

G-P is the world’s first agentic Global Employment Platform built to turn global HR and compliance into a growth engine. We’ve distilled 14+ years of legal and HR expertise into a single, secure tech stack that supports compliant employment in 180+ countries — allowing you to stop managing complexity and start driving revenue. Our technology is engineered to adapt entirely to you — designed to support you at every stage of your growth journey, and integrate securely with the systems you already use. By embedding global labor law intelligence directly into every cross-border workflow, we empower you to scale your workforce in minutes, protect your business from liability, and operate with the agility of a local competitor — anywhere on Earth. 

 

About this Position

We are looking for a mid-level Software Engineer II to design, build, and scale our AI powered product features with agentic experiences using AI agents and multi-agent workflows. Operating at the crossroads of Agentic AI and full-stack product engineering, you will harness the latest foundation or purpose-fit models and modern agent frameworks to resolve intricate business challenges.

 

What you will do:

  • Design, build, and operate production AI features across the stack (APIs, services, and product UI) using modern cloud architectures
  • Design and implement agentic systems: tool-calling agents, multi-step workflows, and multi-agent orchestration patterns with guardrails, authz, rate limits, retries, fallbacks, and safe human-in-the-loop paths
  • Own quality loops: offline/online evals, benchmarks, regression sets, prompt/version management, A/B or canary rollouts, and continuous improvement of evals, accuracy, latency, and cost
  • Instrument AI systems for production: tracing, token/cost metrics, failure taxonomy, grounding/hallucination signals, and operational runbooks
  • Collaborate with Product and UX to translate ambiguous use cases into shippable, measurable outcomes
  • Contribute to shared AI platform patterns (agent frameworks, RAG/retrieval, memory, tool registries, evaluation harnesses) and evolve the SDLC for AI delivery

 

What we're looking for:

  • 3+ years building Agentic / SaaS / enterprise software in distributed teams
  • Strong full-stack foundations: Python, TypeScript, React, Node.js, APIs, and modern databases
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, Strands Agents SDK (or comparable frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or Claude Agent SDK), including function/tool calling, structured outputs, and streaming responses.
  • Deep practical understanding of multi-agent orchestration, context management, and API integrations across models.
  • Hands-on experience shipping, scaling and improving AI applications in production (LLM apps, RAG, copilots, or agent workflows)
  • Working knowledge of agent design: tools/function calling, state/memory, orchestration graphs, and failure handling
  • Familiarity with cloud architectures (AWS preferred) and shipping services with CI/CD, monitoring, and secure defaults
  • Startup / high-growth experience desirable

Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate's relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role.

Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

  • Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.
  • Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary.

Benefits 

G-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more.

 

Individuals residing, or applying to work, in the United States: California or Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, please review the following additional information:

G-P will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Act Ordinance. Los Angeles applicants can review additional information regarding the Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act here: Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and Philadelphia applicants can review information pertaining to Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance here: Fair Chance Poster. Any consideration of a candidate’s background check with arrest or conviction records will include an individualized assessment based on the factors required by applicable law, including the candidate’s specific record and the duties and requirements of the specific job.

G-P. Global Made Possible.

G-P is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to building and maintaining a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity. We prohibit discrimination and harassment against employees or applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

G-P also is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these positions. If you need an accommodation due to a disability during the interview process, please contact us at careers@g-p.com.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Turkey)
description_html:
Headquarters: Turkey
URL: https://sezzle.com

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) 

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500  USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do: 

  • Design software applications and features in Golang and React
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For: 

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You: 

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. 

#Li-remote #Full-time

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-senior-software-engineer-turkey

Senior Software Engineer

Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET)
Contract Type: Full-time
Starting Salary: €55,000 Euros per annum gross, subject to skills, experience and location


Not Your Typical Workplace…

Tired of the 9-to-5 grind? Imagine a world without borders, where opportunities are endless. That's the future of work, and what we're building at WorkMotion.

Our remote-first team spans the globe, helping companies hire, onboard, and manage talent internationally through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Fast-paced, people-driven, and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams without borders.


More Than a Role

We don't just need another Senior Software Engineer—we're looking for a builder who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and delivering scalable, high-quality software that creates real business impact.

You'll play a key role in shaping and building the technology powering our Talent Operations platform, working on backend services while contributing to frontend development when needed. You'll influence technical decisions, contribute to system architecture, and collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that support our global business.

We're looking for engineers who embrace modern software development practices and actively leverage AI-powered development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to improve productivity and code quality.


Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity…
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services while contributing to frontend features where required.
  • Build high-quality, well-tested software following modern engineering and DevOps best practices.
  • Contribute to architecture, system design, and technical decision-making across the platform.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to deliver impactful solutions.
  • Review code, mentor teammates, and continuously improve engineering standards.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and continuously enhance system performance, reliability, and scalability.

What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…
  • 5–6+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong backend focus and frontend exposure.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, React, Microservices, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and AWS.
  • Experience designing scalable systems and distributed architectures.
  • Daily experience using AI coding tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.
  • Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD), software engineering best practices, and clean code principles.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Bonus Points If You Bring…
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum or Kanban).
  • Experience building highly scalable SaaS platforms.
  • Passion for continuous learning and adopting modern engineering practices.

Not Your Typical Team…

You'll join our Talent Operations Engineering Team, where we're building the technology that powers global hiring and talent lifecycle operations.

Our fully remote engineering team collaborates across multiple countries, combining deep technical expertise with a strong ownership mindset. We value pragmatic decision-making, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and shipping high-quality software that solves real business problems.

If you enjoy working with experienced engineers, influencing technical direction, and building products that have global impact, you'll feel right at home.


The Perks of Being Here…
  • Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
  • Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day—a full day off just to recharge and relax.
  • Get fit and stay active: Whether it's yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog, work out on your terms with our subsidised gym memberships.
  • Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. Our Training & Development Allowance helps you continue expanding your skills.
  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups.
  • Diversity is our superpower: We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.



Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations.

At WorkMotion, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, simply let our Recruitment Team know at Jobs@WorkMotion.com. We're here to support you every step of the way.
